title: Employer-ref count-cap error keeps the old 'employer reference' name while sibling upload-validation messages were renamed
evidence: document_upload.gleam:167: `          "One employer reference per adult \u{2014} that\u{2019}s four at most.",` — surfaced to applicants via application_handler.gleam:1452 `    document_upload.CountCapExceeded(message) -> [#("documents", message)]`, while the same PR renamed the sibling required-upload errors for the same slot: application_handler.gleam:964 `      "Upload an employer / business reference confirming your work."` and application_handler.gleam:969 `      "Upload an employer / business reference for "`
detail: Item 1: 'find every instance of the slot label/helper incl. per-co-applicant variants.' The PR renamed the required-upload errors for this slot but left this applicant-facing count-cap error naming the document 'employer reference' — two upload-validation messages for one slot now disagree. Reachable only via crafted multi-file posts (four single-file slots), hence note.
recommended_fix: Change the cap message to 'One employer / business reference per adult — that's four at most.' so all upload-validation copy for the slot uses the ruled label.
